course:
Weakest: it makes no sense why this course is a 3 credit course which is part of the gpa. It would make more sense if it was a pass/fail course. And the grade threshold is ridiculous. 80 is a B-? In order to get an A you can't lose more than 5 points. And listening is ridiculously challenging. They talk so fast and so much. It's impossible for us to know exactly what they're talking about as we hadn't learnt everything they said. And even though we were only requested to selected a few options of words we knew, it was impossible to capture those words when the speakers were talking so fast. I'd love to learn turkish and i was looking forward to it then this course ended that passion of learning.
Turkish students who don't have to take the course are able to have an edge over us due to the unfair grading method. I understand the fact that it's a compulsory course. But if you want to make it compulsory then make it pass/fail so future international students will be able to learn the language without so much unneeded pressure. If making it pass/fail is out of the question then at least reconsider the grading threshold. If that's not possible either then the very least that can be done is to restructure the listening exam to better suit it with the knowledge of the students.

Students can learn basic writting skills but I think the course should focus more on speaking. Also if the teacher speaks more in Turkish the students will have to learn and search for words in order to understand which I believe will help students learn turkish faster.

For me personally.. i like to learn new things but if you tell me i have to get grades and get a good gpa and stuff , it scrubs off all the joy in learning because then im doing it for that purpose only and not for the love of it.

Dersin en olumlu yönü çok fazla olan ingilizce derslerin arasında öğrencilere kafa dağıtmayı sağlaması
En olumsuz yönü ise öğretmene bağlı olarak öğrenciden beklenti düzeyi

Turkce 101 ve Turkce 102 derslerinin kodlari farkli olmasina ragmen; iceriginin, yapilan odevlerin ve sinavlarin birerbir ayni olmasi bu iki dersin birbirlerinden hicbir farki olmadigini ve her iki dersinde ogrenciye ayni getirileri saglayacagini gosterir. Onceden belirlenen odev listelerinin (roman, gezi, siir vb.) 101'den 102 dersine gecerken bir tanesinin dahi degistirilmemis olmasi hayret verici. Oyleki, 101 dersinden gecip, 102 alan bir ogrencinin dersten kalmasi olasilik disidir. Sirf kodunun degistigi, iceriginin tamamen ayni kaldigi bu dersi gecen donem iyi bir notla verdigim icin, ve bu donem tekrardan ayni dersi almanin bana vakit kaybinin yani sira hicbir getirirsinin olmayacagini ongorerek odevlerimi tamamlamamis ve final sinavina girmemis bulunuyorum. Sinirli sayida withdraw hakki sunuldugu icin, bu hakkimi bosuna kullanmak yerine bir dahaki donem dersi almayi tercih ettim. Genelde cala kalem doldurulan bu degerlendirme anketlerinin okunacagini umuyorum ve Turkce 101, 102 derslerini alan bir ogrencinin her ikisindede farkli perspektiflerden çözümleyici, bilimsel, eleştirel ve yaratıcı düşünce bazinda kendilerini gelistirmeleri ve yeni seyler ogrenmeleri adina bu iki dersin iceriklerinin degistirilmesi gerektigini dusunuyorum. Saygilarimla.

+Özellikle İngilizce üzerine kurulu eğitim hayatında biraz rahatlama ve yaratıcı olma ortamı sunuyor.
+Ders yükü çok ağır değil, düzenli olmak ve belli başlı düşünceler üzerinde yazabilme yetisi çok rahat yetiyor, bu da dersten soğutmuyor.
